mapper.sql: daily_quest_id, user_id, quest_date, status, total_count, correct_count, score, reward_policy_id, point_transaction_id, completed_at
daily_quest_item_id, daily_quest_id, question_id, display_order, question_snapshot_json, user_answer_json, is_correct, answered_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM daily_quests WHERE daily_quest_id = #{dailyQuestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM daily_quest_items WHERE daily_quest_id = #{dailyQuestId} ORDER BY display_order

SELECT item.daily_quest_item_id, item.daily_quest_id, item.question_id, item.display_order, item.question_snapshot_json, item.user_answer_json, item.is_correct, item.answered_at, item.created_at FROM daily_quest_items item INNER JOIN daily_quests quest ON quest.daily_quest_id = item.daily_quest_id WHERE item.daily_quest_item_id = #{dailyQuestItemId} AND quest.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_quest_items WHERE daily_quest_id = #{dailyQuestId} AND user_answer_json IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_quests ( user_id, quest_date, status, total_count, correct_count, score, reward_policy_id, point_transaction_id, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{questDate}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, #{correctCount}, #{score}, #{rewardPolicyId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{pointTransactionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )

INSERT INTO daily_quest_items ( daily_quest_id, question_id, display_order, question_snapshot_json, user_answer_json, is_correct, answered_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{dailyQuestId}, #{questionId}, #{displayOrder}, #{questionSnapshotJson}, #{userAnswerJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{correct,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{answeredAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt} )
